modelPlan.focus: Explore the benefits and drawbacks of constant social media connectivity, balancing between enhanced communication and potential negative impacts on mental well-being and relationships.
outline: Body 2: Disadvantages of Excessive Social Media Use
keyArguments: Social media fosters instant communication and access to information, strengthening relationships.
Overuse can lead to mental health issues, reduced attention spans, and strained relationships due to constant distractions and misinformation.

plan.focus: Explore the benefits and drawbacks of constant social media connectivity, balancing between enhanced communication and potential negative impacts on mental well-being and relationships.
outline: Body 2: Disadvantages of Excessive Social Media Use
keyArguments: Social media fosters instant communication and access to information, strengthening relationships.
Overuse can lead to mental health issues, reduced attention spans, and strained relationships due to constant distractions and misinformation.
